scope_notes: Covers the TensorRT-LLM v0.21.0 PUBLIC config surface a benchmark caller can plausibly touch.

v0.21 SPLIT the monolithic LlmArgs into BaseLlmArgs + TrtLlmArgs + TorchLlmArgs (introduced in this pin). LlmArgs alias resolves to TrtLlmArgs (llmapi/llm_args.py:1594). BaseLlmArgs holds the shared surface; TrtLlmArgs adds AOT-engine-build knobs; TorchLlmArgs adds the PyTorch backend knobs (used when backend=='pytorch'). All three are catalogued.
Citations use 1-based line numbers as displayed by Read tool against /tmp/trial_tensorrt_v0_21_0_venv/src/tensorrt_llm/. Paths are RELATIVE to the tensorrt_llm package root.

Field 'type' uses JSON-schema-ish lowercase strings ('string','integer','number','boolean','array','object','null'). 'Any'/opaque objects encode as {'type':'object','description':<repr>}. Literal/StrEnum allowlists appear as 'enum'.

tensorrt_llm.bindings.executor (C++ pybind module, shipped as bindings.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so) is the underlying runtime config layer. The Python BaseModel mirrors (KvCacheConfig, SchedulerConfig, PeftCacheConfig, ExtendedRuntimePerfKnobConfig, CacheTransceiverConfig, DynamicBatchConfig, LookaheadDecodingConfig) are decorated with @PybindMirror.mirror_pybind_fields(<C++ class>) and asserted to mirror the C++ class fields (llmapi/llm_args.py:309-397). The Python class is therefore the authoritative source for the field surface at this pin. The raw ExecutorConfig (tensorrt_llm.bindings.executor.ExecutorConfig) is NOT user-constructed in the LLM-API path; BaseLlmArgs is constructed and then translated into ExecutorConfig internally (with a runtime assertion at llmapi/llm_args.py:1044 that BaseLlmArgs covers every ExecutorConfig attr).

PluginConfig fields are dataclass-defined with a '_' storage prefix and metaclass-generated properties (plugin/plugin.py:130-138); we list properties (the prefix stripped). cli_plugin_args (plugin/plugin.py:588-619) marks the subset exposed via trtllm-build CLI; others 'are automatically enabled when needed, no need for users to control' per the source comment.

engine_envs namespace enumerates every TLLM_*/TRTLLM_* env var that the Python source reads at runtime. Some are aliases (TLLM_<name> and TRTLLM_<name> exist for the same feature; both are listed where present in source). C++-only env vars (read from the bindings .so but never named in Python) are out of scope for this source-walk and flagged in methodology.md.

Speculative decoding has SEVEN config classes in this pin: LookaheadDecodingConfig (Pybind-mirrored), MedusaDecodingConfig, EagleDecodingConfig, NGramDecodingConfig, DraftTargetDecodingConfig, MTPDecodingConfig (all inherit from DecodingBaseConfig). All seven are catalogued under subconfigs.speculative_*. DecodingBaseConfig itself contributes max_draft_len + speculative_model.

GenerationConfig: TRT-LLM does NOT define its own GenerationConfig class at this pin. The HuggingFace-style generation surface is reached via SamplingParams (engine-side request-time config) and the engine-build-time BuildConfig.max_draft_len / max_beam_width / max_seq_len. (Confirmed: grep '^class GenerationConfig' returns nothing under tensorrt_llm/.) See methodology.md.

engine_params_base._note: Pydantic BaseModel with model_config={'arbitrary_types_allowed':True,'extra':'forbid'} (line 765-768). Shared base for TrtLlmArgs and TorchLlmArgs.

model.description: Path to model checkpoint or HF Hub name. Union[str, Path].

dtype.constraint: Pre SM 80 GPUs (compute capability < 8.0): 'auto' coerces to 'float16'; 'bfloat16' raises RuntimeError

gpus_per_node.normalisation: If None, defaults to torch.cuda.device_count() with a logger.warning.

moe_cluster_parallel_size.normalisation: If None, coerced to -1 in validate_parallel_config (line 1086).

load_format._note: TorchLlmArgs OVERRIDES this field to a Union[str, LoadFormat] with enum LoadFormat={AUTO, DUMMY} (line 1711) and a before-validator (line 1730).

quant_config.default_note: None coerced to QuantConfig() by validator

speculative_config.constraint: validator dispatches by isinstance() on the six known speculative-config classes; unknown subclass raises ValueError 'Speculative config type not recognized'.

max_batch_size.constraint: If set AND > build_config.max_batch_size: raises ValueError. If set AND backend=='pytorch' AND differs from build_config: warns and overrides (line 1186-1204).

max_input_len.constraint: If set AND differs from build_config.max_input_len: warns (line 1236-1239).

max_seq_len.constraint: If set AND differs from build_config.max_seq_len: warns (line 1226-1230).

max_beam_width.default_note: validate_build_config_remaining (line 1264-1268) coerces None to build_config.max_beam_width or 1.
max_beam_width.constraint: If set AND differs from build_config.max_beam_width: warns (line 1231-1235).

max_num_tokens.constraint: If set AND > build_config.max_num_tokens: raises ValueError (line 1221-1225).

backend.default_note: TorchLlmArgs subclass overrides default to 'pytorch' via init_backend (line 1724-1728)
backend._branching_note: Several validators branch on backend in {'pytorch','_autodeploy'} vs not (e.g. validate_model_format_misc line 1124, validate_lora_config_consistency line 1372, set_runtime_knobs_from_build_config line 1186).

engine_params_trt._note: TrtLlmArgs is the AOT TRT-engine build path (default when backend is unset / not 'pytorch' / not '_autodeploy'). LlmArgs = TrtLlmArgs alias at line 1594.

enable_build_cache.constraint: Truthy bool is coerced to BuildCacheConfig(); non-bool non-BuildCacheConfig raises ValueError 'Invalid build_cache_config'.

calib_config.default_note: None coerced to CalibConfig() by before-validator (line 1542-1547)

embedding_parallel_mode.constraint: Sets _convert_checkpoint_options based on value; no else branch -> values outside the three known names silently no-op (NOT raised).

build_config.default_note: init_build_config (line 1162-1184) creates BuildConfig() with max_batch_size/max_num_tokens/max_seq_len/max_beam_width/max_input_len populated from BaseLlmArgs when None.

engine_params_torch._note: TorchLlmArgs is the PyTorch (eager / torch.compile) backend (backend=='pytorch'). Not used by the AOT TRT path. _AutoDeployLlmArgs subclasses TorchLlmArgs for the '_autodeploy' backend.

build_config._note: Re-declared as Optional[object] with exclude_from_json=True 'to allow code reuse with the TrtLlmArgs' (line 1626-1631).

cuda_graph_batch_sizes.constraint: If non-empty AND cuda_graph_max_batch_size != 0 AND list != _generate_cuda_graph_batch_sizes(max_bs, padding): raises ValueError. If None, regenerated from cuda_graph_max_batch_size or 128.

cuda_graph_max_batch_size.constraint: Must be >= 0; negative values raise ValueError.

moe_load_balancer.constraint: If str: must point to a yaml file that exists and parses; else FileNotFoundError or ValueError.

load_format.constraint: String coerced via .upper() and looked up in LoadFormat.__members__; missing key raises ValueError 'Invalid LoadFormat'.

sampling_params._note: Dataclass with @dataclass(slots=True, kw_only=True). Validated in __post_init__ + _validate (line 273-315). Internally dispatches to tllme.SamplingConfig, tllme.OutputConfig, tllme.GuidedDecodingParams.

best_of.constraint: best_of >= n required; best_of > 1 under greedy decoding raises unless TLLM_ALLOW_N_GREEDY_DECODING=1 in env.

truncate_prompt_tokens.constraint: If not None: must be >= 1; else ValueError.

guided_decoding_params._note: Dataclass with @dataclass(slots=True, kw_only=True). Mutually-exclusive guide selectors (only one may be set), enforced in _validate.

grammar._note: Used as an EBNF (Extended Backus-Naur Form) grammar.

CalibConfig._note: Pydantic BaseModel. Quantization-calibration knobs. NOT in baseline schema.discovered.json (only its 'device' enum landed via a Literal probe).

KvCacheConfig._note: Pydantic BaseModel decorated with @PybindMirror.mirror_pybind_fields(_KvCacheConfig). Mirror-decorator asserts every C++ field has a Python counterpart at class-construction time (line 326-353).

free_gpu_memory_fraction.default_note: Default is 90% (per docstring); coerced by C++ side.

cross_kv_cache_fraction.default_note: Default 50% per docstring; only set for encoder-decoder models.

DynamicBatchConfig._note: Pybind-mirrored. All three fields are required (no Pydantic default).

ExtendedRuntimePerfKnobConfig._note: Pybind-mirrored. cuda_graph_mode/cache_size set on the C++ object AFTER construction (line 703-704); not constructor args.

LookaheadDecodingConfig._note: Inherits from DecodingBaseConfig + PybindMirror. decoding_type ClassVar='Lookahead' (line 598). Defaults come from the C++ side via _LookaheadDecodingConfig.get_default_lookahead_decoding_*() at class-load time.

max_window_size.constraint: must be > 0; else ValueError 'Value must be positive'

EagleDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='Eagle' (line 249). When backend in {'pytorch','_autodeploy'}, BaseLlmArgs.validate_speculative_config (line 1312-1319) REPLACES the EagleDecodingConfig instance with a torch.speculative.Eagle3Config carrying (max_draft_tokens, draft_model_path, eagle3_one_model).

NGramDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='NGram' (line 283). validate_speculative_config (line 1320-1334) ASSERTS backend in {'pytorch','_autodeploy'} when this config is in use. Validator replaces the config with torch.speculative.NGramConfig.

MTPDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='MTP' (line 306). Multi-Token Prediction (DeepSeek-style). Validator (line 1345-1354) replaces with torch.speculative.MTPConfig.

DecodingBaseConfig._note: Shared base for all speculative-decoding configs. from_dict dispatches by 'decoding_type' key into {MTP, Medusa, Eagle, Lookahead, NGram, DraftTarget}; unknown raises ValueError 'Invalid decoding type'.

QuantConfig._note: Stdlib @dataclass (not Pydantic). Validation lives at engine-build (C++) - constructor itself does not validate the allowlist.

kv_cache_quant_algo._note: Allowlist is the KV_CACHE_QUANT_ALGO_LIST constant, a strict subset of QuantAlgo.

BuildConfig._note: Stdlib @dataclass. The AOT TRT engine-build config. Heavily underspecified in baseline schema.discovered.json (only declared as opaque 'object').

kv_cache_type._note: Coerced based on plugin_config.paged_kv_cache / paged_state interaction. Default ends up PAGED after update_kv_cache_type.

BuildCacheConfig._note: Plain class (not @dataclass). Fields stored as private _cache_root / _max_records / _max_cache_storage_gb with property accessors.

cache_root.default_note: If None: falls back to env TLLM_LLMAPI_BUILD_CACHE_ROOT or '/tmp/.cache/tensorrt_llm/llmapi/' (line 25-27).

max_records.constraint: BuildCache.__init__ raises ValueError if max_records < 1 ('max_records should be greater than 0').

PluginConfig._note: @dataclass(slots=True) with PluginConfigMeta metaclass. Storage fields all prefixed '_'; PluginConfigMeta generates a property with the prefix stripped (line 130-138). Properties expose typed setters: bool fields assert isinstance(value, bool); str-typed plugin fields assert value in PLUGIN_DTYPE_OPTIONS allowlist (line 113-118). 'auto' as a value RETURNS the dtype field via the getter (line 103-106). cli_plugin_args (line 588-619) marks the 28 fields exposed via the trtllm-build CLI; the rest are internal.

dtype.validator_constraint: Plugin dtype cannot be 'auto' or None (line 119-121).

manage_weights._note: Auto-enabled in BaseLlmArgs.validate_build_config_remaining when fast_build AND quant_algo==FP8 (line 1249-1251).

validate._note: PluginConfig.validate() (line 499-514) raises NotImplementedError on SM 10.0 (Blackwell) for: gemm_swiglu_plugin, fp8_rowwise_gemm_plugin, low_latency_gemm_plugin, low_latency_gemm_swiglu_plugin, bert_context_fmha_fp32_acc when set to non-False values.

TorchCompileConfig._note: Pydantic BaseModel. Only consulted on the TorchLlmArgs path.

_source._note: All TLLM_*/TRTLLM_* environment variables READ at runtime by the Python source tree under /tmp/trial_tensorrt_v0_21_0_venv/src/tensorrt_llm/. Variables read only by the C++ pybind .so (bindings.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so) are out of source-walk scope and flagged in methodology.md.

TLLM_LOG_LEVEL.behaviour: Sets the tensorrt_llm.logger root level at import time.

TLLM_ALLOW_N_GREEDY_DECODING.behaviour: If '1', allows SamplingParams.best_of > 1 under greedy decoding (otherwise raises ValueError in SamplingParams._validate).

TLLM_LLMAPI_BUILD_CACHE.behaviour: If '1', enables BuildCache by default for llmapi LLM(...) calls.

TLLM_LLMAPI_BUILD_CACHE_ROOT.behaviour: Root directory for the llmapi build cache.

TLLM_LLMAPI_ENABLE_NVTX.behaviour: If '1', enables NVTX range emission inside llmapi.

TLLM_NVTX_DEBUG.behaviour: Alias for TLLM_LLMAPI_ENABLE_NVTX (also triggers NVTX emission).

TLLM_LLM_ENABLE_DEBUG.behaviour: Enable verbose debug behaviour in llmapi utils (e.g. extra prints, longer timeouts).

TLLM_WORKER_USE_SINGLE_PROCESS.behaviour: Force the LLM worker to share the engine's process (helpful for return-logits perf and debugging).

TLLM_OVERRIDE_LAYER_NUM.behaviour: If > 0, overrides the loaded model's layer count (PyTorch backend model_engine). Used for dummy/small-model tests.

TLLM_PROFILE_START_STOP.behaviour: If set, controls when the PyTorch executor starts/stops profiling (iteration-range string).

TLLM_PROFILE_RECORD_GC.behaviour: If set, record Python gc events in the executor profile.

TLLM_TORCH_PROFILE_TRACE.behaviour: If set to a path, writes a torch.profiler trace file there.

TLLM_TRACE_EXECUTOR_LOOP.behaviour: Enable tracing of the per-iteration executor loop.

TLLM_TRACE_MODEL_FORWARD.behaviour: Enable tracing of the model forward pass in PyTorch backend.

TLLM_DISABLE_FP4_ALLGATHER.behaviour: If '1', disables FP4 allgather in the torch backend.

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS.behaviour: If '1', the LLM-API spawns a proxy process. (LlmLauncherEnvs enum.)

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS_IPC_ADDR.behaviour: IPC address for the spawned proxy.

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS_IPC_HMAC_KEY.behaviour: HMAC key for the spawned proxy IPC.

TLLM_EXECUTOR_PERIODICAL_RESP_IN_AWAIT.behaviour: If set, the executor uses a periodical response handler in await_responses (LlmLauncherEnvs enum).

TLLM_MULTIMODAL_DISAGGREGATED.behaviour: If '1', enables disaggregated multimodal modeling for HyperCLOVA-X (and any model gating on the DISAGG flag).

TLLM_DISAGG_INSTANCE_IDX.behaviour: Per-instance index for disaggregated serve launches.

TLLM_DISAGG_RUN_REMOTE_MPI_SESSION_CLIEN.behaviour: If '1', the disagg launcher uses the remote MPI session client.

TRTLLM_USE_UCX_KVCACHE.behaviour: If set, KV cache transceiver uses UCX (mutually exclusive with NIXL and MPI variants below; first-match wins).

TRTLLM_USE_NIXL_KVCACHE.behaviour: If set, KV cache transceiver uses NIXL.

TRTLLM_USE_MPI_KVCACHE.behaviour: If set, KV cache transceiver uses MPI. Force-set to '1' by the disagg-serve launcher (commands/serve.py:431).

TRTLLM_DISAGG_BENCHMARK_GEN_ONLY.behaviour: If '1', the OpenAI-compatible disagg server runs in generate-only benchmark mode (no context server required).

TRTLLM_DISABLE_KV_CACHE_TRANSFER_OVERLAP.behaviour: If '1', disables overlap of KV cache transfer with compute in the PyTorch executor.

TRTLLM_ENABLE_ATTENTION_NVFP4_OUTPUT.behaviour: Whether the TRTLLM attention backend emits NVFP4 outputs. Default enabled; set '0' to disable.

TRTLLM_ENABLE_PDL.behaviour: Enable Programmatic Dependent Launch (PDL) in FlashInfer custom ops. Force-set to '1' by the low-latency bench script.

TRTLLM_MOE_POST_QUANT_ALLTOALLV.behaviour: If '1' (default), apply alltoallv after post-quant in fused-MoE cutlass path.

TRTLLM_MOE_DISABLE_ALLTOALLV.behaviour: If '1', disables alltoallv entirely in fused-MoE cutlass.

TRTLLM_FORCE_MNNVL_AR.behaviour: If '1', force MNNVL all-reduce in distributed ops.

TRTLLM_DEEPSEEK_EAGER_FUSION_DISABLED.behaviour: If '1', disables DeepSeek-v3 eager fusion path.

TRTLLM_QWEN3_EAGER_FUSION_DISABLED.behaviour: If '1', disables Qwen3-MoE eager fusion path.

TRTLLM_ENABLE_MMHA_MULTI_BLOCK_DEBUG.behaviour: If '1', enables MMHA multi-block debug. Set by the low-latency bench script.

TRTLLM_MMHA_KERNEL_BLOCK_SIZE.behaviour: Override MMHA kernel block size. Set to '256' by the low-latency bench script.

TRTLLM_DISABLE_UNIFIED_CONVERTER.behaviour: If '1', disables the unified checkpoint converter path.

source._note: Referenced in source (sole hit); behaviour-detail not extracted in this scan.

TRTLLM_DG_JIT_USE_NVCC.behaviour: DeepGEMM JIT use NVCC for compilation.
